title: White City 9 km²
description: 3 × 3 km around Television Centre, Westfield and the Imperial College White City campus. 2 m voxel geometry from the uploaded GLB; wind from the SCALED latent surrogate (8 m coarse frames), temperature from the 3-D physical solver, pollution from the upwind transport solver, sunlight and flooding from the fixed-operator surface models; TfL tube, rail and bus network, road disruptions and traffic cameras from the TfL Unified API.

focus.label: Television Centre, Westfield and the White City campus

solar.label: Sunlight · clear-sky shadows and irradiance
solar.title: Sunlight · clear-sky shadows and irradiance (assumed north = local +y)

poll.label: Pollution · 8–16 m tracer layer (assumed line source)
poll.title: Pollution · 8–16 m tracer concentration (assumed upstream line source)

flood.label: Flooding · surface water depth (3 h cloudburst)
flood.title: Flooding · surface water depth (3 h cloudburst, 2 m shallow-water model on the GLB ground)

limits: Georeferenced by fitting 939 named OSM buildings to the GLB (median residual 1.6 m): local +y points 2.2° east of true north (UTM grid north). The sun model assumed local +y = north, a 2° azimuth error.
Wind: SCALED surrogate transferred to new geometry, no CFD or measured validation; 50 s per step is a grid-scaled interpretation.
Temperature: controlled scenario (26 °C air, 30 °C surfaces), not measured White City temperatures.
Pollution: assumed upstream line source, not measured concentrations.
Flooding: the GLB ground mesh stands in for terrain; no surveyed elevation.
Transport: a TfL Unified API snapshot (routes, stops, road disruptions, JamCams); arrivals refresh live while online.
